situation: Got a DM from a coffee subscription brand, Ridgeline, saying 'love your content, want to collab?' That's it. I have 45k on Instagram and I actually drink their stuff.
reply: Hi Ben, thanks for reaching out, I've actually been drinking your Ethiopia roast for months. To put together a proper proposal, could you share what deliverables you have in mind (reel, stories, feed post), the timeline, whether there's paid usage or exclusivity involved, and the budget range? Once I have that I'll come back within a day.
note: Genuine liking is mentioned once; no enthusiasm is spent before the terms are known.

situation: Uma marca de biquínis me mandou DM oferecendo 3 peças em troca de um reels e 3 stories. Tenho 22 mil seguidores e não faço permuta.
reply: Oi, Rafa! Obrigada pelo convite, curti muito a coleção nova de vocês. Não faço conteúdo em troca de produto, porque o trabalho é o mesmo de qualquer jeito, mas topo conversar sobre um reels pago se couber no orçamento. Meu valor para um reels com 30 dias de uso orgânico começa em R$ 1.500. Se não der agora, boa sorte no lançamento!

situation: 一个国产护肤品牌找我做小红书笔记，预算2000，但要求永久授权还能投流。我平时单篇图文报价3000，含30天授权。
reply: 谢谢你们直接说预算。2000的话，我可以做一篇图文笔记，含30天自然流量授权，不含投流。如果需要投流或更长的授权，一般按内容费的30%每90天另计。你们大概打算投多久？我按实际需要给一个最简单的方案。
note: 授权和投流是钱藏着的地方：保住底价，用缩小交付范围来匹配预算。

situation: I'm a fitness creator on TikTok, 120k followers, a lot of them 16 to 20. A sports betting app, BetBlitz, offered $2,500 for one video. Their contact is Jordan. Easy money but not right for my audience.
reply: Hi Jordan, thanks for the offer and the clear brief. Sports betting isn't a fit for my audience, so I'm going to pass on this one. Wishing you a good campaign.
note: Decline mismatches fast, with no lecture about their product and no counteroffer; brands talk, and a clean no protects your reputation.

situation: I sent a quote to a kitchenware brand, Oakfield, on Sept 21: $900 for one TikTok with 30 days of organic usage. The contact, Priya, went quiet. It's been 8 days. Worth one follow-up?
reply: Hi Priya, just following up on the proposal I sent on 21 September for the Oakfield cast iron video. If the budget or timing has shifted, tell me and I'm happy to suggest a smaller option, like a story set of three. If it's not going ahead, no problem at all, and I'd be glad to hear from you for a future campaign.
note: One follow-up after a week, with an easy smaller option and an easy no. If this gets silence too, treat it as a no and move on.

situation: 和一个露营装备品牌谈好了：一条抖音视频加三篇小红书图文，10月15号到25号之间发，总价8000元，先付一半，含30天授权，不排他。对接人是小林，想发条消息把条款确认下来。
reply: 小林你好，确认一下我们谈好的内容：一条抖音视频加三篇小红书图文，10月15日到25日之间发布，总价8000元，签约后预付50%，交付后付剩余50%，含30天自然流量授权，不含投流，不排他。今天我会把预付款的发票和内容脚本发你，脚本确认后就开始拍。如果哪一项和你的理解不一样，直接告诉我。
note: 条款、付款方式和授权范围都落在文字里再开工，确认消息本身就是合同的草稿。

situation: A protein bar brand, Fuelwell, offered $1,200 for one YouTube integration on my running channel (80k subs). Their contract, from Nina, asks for 6 months of category exclusivity covering all nutrition brands. I already have an ongoing paid partnership with an electrolyte brand.
reply: Hi Nina, thanks for sending the contract, the integration itself looks great. The one sticking point is exclusivity: I have an ongoing nutrition partnership, so six months across all nutrition brands isn't possible for me. Two options: 60 days of exclusivity on protein bars and snacks, included at $1,200, or six months on protein bars and snacks for $1,800. Which suits Fuelwell better?
note: Exclusivity is where the money hides: narrow the category, price the longer term, and keep existing partners out of it.

situation: Skincare brand Lumen paid $1,200 for one TikTok. They approved my script, I filmed it and did the one round of revisions in our contract on Sept 24. Now their manager Ellie wants a full reshoot with a different outfit and a new opening hook.
reply: Hi Ellie, happy to help get this one right. The brief included one round of revisions, which we used on 24 September, so a full reshoot sits outside the original scope. I can reshoot with the new outfit and hook for $400, delivered by Friday 2 October. If you'd rather stay within the current budget, I can recut the existing footage with a new text hook at no charge by tomorrow. Which would you prefer?
note: Scope creep after delivery: point to the brief once, price the extra work, and offer a free smaller fix so saying yes is easy either way.

situation: J'ai refusé une collab « contre produits » avec une marque de bougies et j'ai proposé une story payée à 250 euros. La responsable, Camille, m'a répondu : « D'autres créatrices le font gratuitement, vous savez. » J'ai 30 000 abonnés sur Instagram.
reply: Bonjour Camille, c'est tout à fait normal, et je comprends que ça marche pour certaines. Je ne suis simplement pas la bonne personne pour cette campagne. Bonne continuation pour le lancement, et si un budget se libère plus tard, je serai ravie d'en reparler.
note: Quand la marque se braque, on ne débat pas du marché : une ligne courtoise, la porte reste ouverte, et on passe à autre chose.
